What's-the-rumpus liver pâté toasts.d: Chicken liver pâté, brandy, thyme, hot rye toast.
What's-the-rumpus liver pâté toasts.note: Say the word at the door first.

Johnny Caspar's cheese straws.d: Twisted puff pastry, cheddar, parmesan, cayenne.
Johnny Caspar's cheese straws.note: A question of ethics, Johnny says.

Leo's Danny Boy Irish stew.d: Lamb neck chops, potatoes, carrots, onions, stout.
Leo's Danny Boy Irish stew.note: Danny Boy on the gramophone while it braises.

Whisky bread pudding.d: Brioche, raisins soaked in the good Irish, custard.
Whisky bread pudding.note: Short at the bill? Look in your heart.

Tom Reagan's hot Irish whiskey toddy.d: Irish whiskey, honey, lemon, clove, cinnamon stick.
Tom Reagan's hot Irish whiskey toddy.note: Served in a teacup. Hat to the check room.
